The Sprint Project was a collaborative assignment in which we developed a prototype for a new concept utilizing the “Sprint” project management methodology. Our team focused on creating a scheduling system for the professional messaging platform Slack. We used Figma for ideation, delegation, and development, organizing our tasks on separate art boards for each day of the sprint, detailing what needed to be accomplished and tracking our progress.
